connector.name: Specter Skills
connector.registryDescription: Configure a Specter game backend from chat: economy, progression, leaderboards, multiplayer.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package specter-skills. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dirtcubeinteractive account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPECTER_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
env.description: Set 'true' to enable the create/mutate tools (gated behind confirmation)

env.name: SPECTER_API_KEY
env.description: Client api-key. Not needed after browser sign-in (the dev key from login is reused)

env.name: SPECTER_PROJECT_ID
env.description: Auto-detected from sign-in. Set only to pin one project when your org has several

env.name: SPECTER_ADMIN_TOKEN
env.description: Admin token for CI / non-interactive use instead of browser sign-in
